prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a refined character turnaround sheet for 咘咘, an anthropomorphic hamster representing ordinary grassroots restaurant workers in AstralPact. Landscape 3:2, three full-body views front, left-facing profile, rear, consistent identity and outfit, plain warm light gray studio background, no text. Image 1 is the edit target and authoritative for hamster identity: preserve golden brown and cream fur distribution, round ears, broad soft cheek pouches, small dark eyes, pink nose, two visible incisors, stocky approachable proportions, animal paws. Image 2 is ONLY rendering/material quality reference; do not copy dragon anatomy, jewelry, palace, colors or costume. Modify the old artisan accessories into modest practical small-restaurant worker clothing: simple low soft off-white kitchen cloth cap fitted between the ears, faded cream collared work shirt with sleeves rolled to elbows; remove leather vest and heavy leather harness; faded dark teal cotton bib apron with simple fabric neck strap and tied waist, hem ending above knees, clean but well-used with subtle washed fabric fading and one neatly repaired seam, no ragged holes or exaggerated dirt. One short wooden-handled stainless steel cooking ladle held naturally in one paw in the front and side view (not also in rear view); folded oatmeal cotton wiping towel tucked securely at waist, small plain order pad and stub pencil in apron chest pocket. Remove all scrolls, money pouch, tool chest and heavy belt. Dark brown practical trousers, both complete legs visible, plain dark slip-resistant closed work shoes adapted to hamster feet. Upright relaxed standing pose, forepaws visible, gentle slightly tired yet alert dignified expression, modest working person, not a fancy executive chef. Consistent cap, towel, apron straps and accessories in all three views; ladle in same physical hand, occluded naturally from rear. High-end feature-film CGI, individually resolved layered hamster fur, physically based rough cotton weave and seams, believable steel ladle with restrained reflections, soft cinematic warm key and subtle cool fill, natural contact shadows, crisp natural detail, all heads ears shoes fully in frame. No cartoon outlines, paper texture, painterly rendering, plastic toy gloss, gold ornament, chef tall toque, distress caricature, human hands, extra limbs, additional characters, text or watermark.
